author: Miguel Tovar
text: Just had my Septic tank emptied by Blackburn Brothers Septic, potty, and plumbing. Scott did a awesome job. Charged me a fair price and exactly what he quoted. No hidden fee's costs or baloney! He was also the best priced. Thank you Scott. I will definitely use you guys again. You da man!

author: Mindy Lin
text: Highly recommend. I contacted Blackburn Bros to inquire about septic pumping for routine maintenance on a couple of tanks on my property. Scott patiently and thoroughly answered all my questions and was able to come out the following day. He called before heading over to make sure the time would work and we worked out a timeframe that fit around some meetings I had. He showed up as expected and answered more questions and got right to work for a reasonable price. He was able to help me determine my tank sizes and explained how everything worked and entertained all my inquiries about connecting other buildings to existing tanks and pretty much every possibility under the sun. I got a full crash course education on septic systems, pumping, treatment facilities and more. Besides that Scott is a friendly and cool dude. I wouldn’t trust anyone else for the job going forward.

author: Avery Glasgow
text: We have gone through Blackburn Brothers twice now and both times Scott has gone above and beyond. He taught us the ins and outs of a septic system and how to take care of it. Great company, will always recommend!!

author: James
text: Great experience! Worked with my schedule and offered a good price for residential septic pumping in Willard, MO. I will continue to use their services. Thanks again!

author: Kaitlin Wagner
text: We had our septic tank pumped by this company. The owner was super nice and communicative about when he would be arriving on the day of. He was on time, and it didn’t cost more than he quoted on the phone. After calling around to several businesses he was a flat rate with no “if something happens it’s gonna be more.” I would 100% recommend this company to anyone looking for services they provide! Very professional, great value, quality and responsiveness.
